acceptedScope: Limited Chinese-name small UTF-8/LF text open, ordinary replacement, ASCII append, GUI Save As and explicit fresh-process reopen; independent market generation, cached same-version update, exact original generation rollback and normal Core/Store restart.

entry.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (main program; bundled licence closure unverified)

summary.en: Limited small UTF-8 text open, replacement, ASCII edit, save and fresh-process reopen tested; TeX typesetting, PDF preview and advanced features unverified.
summary.zhCN: 小型 UTF-8 文本打开、普通替换、ASCII 编辑、保存与新进程重开已测；TeX 排版、PDF 预览及高级功能未验收

limitations: Only two small fixed Chinese-name UTF-8/LF text inputs (147 and 158 bytes), ordinary BEFORE to AFTER replacement, ASCII comment append, GUI Save As to ASCII output paths and explicit new-process reopen were verified.
TeX compilation/typesetting, PDF preview, SyncTeX, spell checking, scripting, templates, advanced features, large files, other encodings and direct Chinese keyboard input were not verified.

Main program GPL-2.0-or-later from fixed source; installed COPYING matches after 339 CRLF normalizations, not raw bytes. Full Qt/Poppler/Hunspell/SyncTeX/Lua/icons and bundled licence closure, Authenticode and reproducibility not verified.
Guest online download, fresh-machine registration, configuration migration and cross-version upgrades were not verified.
Update and rollback submitted via Store IPC; GUI update/rollback button functionality not claimed.
Data preservation covers prior fixed acceptance data, new fixed inputs/outputs/executable/licence and new generation registry pins; not a traversal of every application filesystem file.
